# Cached data for Quran 1:4

## Arabic (Uthmani)
مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

## Khattab — The Clear Quran
"Master of the Day of Judgment."

## Word-by-word
1. مَـٰلِكِ | māliki | (The) Master / Owner
2. يَوْمِ | yawmi | (of the) Day
3. ٱلدِّينِ | l-dīni | (of the) Judgment / Recompense

## Note on qira'at
Two well-known canonical readings: مَـٰلِكِ ("Maalik" — Master/Owner) and مَلِكِ ("Malik" — King). Both are mutawatir. Hafs 'an 'Asim (the standard print here) reads مَـٰلِكِ. The recite skill should mention this only briefly within the tafseer paragraph if it serves the meaning — not as a separate qira'at debate.
